JARA TAFSEEER SE BATAYE Narrated with sound chains from Dhu Mikhbar al-Najashi: " You will make a firm truce with the Romans (al-Rum) until you and they wage a campaign against an enemy that is attacking them. You will be granted victory and great spoils. Then you will alight in a plain surrounded by hills. There, someone among the Romans shall say: 'The Cross has overcome!' whereupon someone among the Muslims shall say: 'Nay, Allah has overcome!' and shall go and break the cross. The Romans shall kill him, then the Muslims shall take up their arms and the two sides shall fall upon each other. Allah shall grant martyrdom to that group of Muslims. After that the Romans shall say to their leader: 'We shall relieve you of the Arabs,' and they shall gather up for the great battle. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 146368 Country: India Title: Is Hijamah permissible as per Hanafi scholars? Question: I m a Hanafi. Is Hijamah permissible as per Hanafi scholars? I heard from an Alim that it is not allowed as per Hanafi madhhab. Please reply. Answer ID: 146368 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 250/240/M=3/1438) Hijamah means cupping. This is done to draw toxic blood from the body to reduce the intensity of the blood in the body. Several Hadiths prove it. The Holy Prophet Muhammad (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) got himself cupped and declared it best remedy. خير ما تداويتم به الحجامة . Hijamah has been declared to be mustahab in the famous Fatawa book of Hanafi Madhhab i.e. Fatawa Hindiya with reference to Zahiriyah. و تستحب الحجامة لكل واحد كذا فى الظهيرية . So, there is no reason being it unlawful. However, the physicians say that Hijamah is comparatively more useful for those who stay in hot areas and are of hot-natured. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
